relevance_note: Supplementary Table S1 ('Characteristics of patients with HA20.') lists 34 individually labelled patients (HA20-1 to HA20-34) with their germline TNFAIP3 variants, and the text gives individual details for HA20-1, HA20-14 and HA20-15.
method_note: A script transcribed supplementary Table S1 (labels, family, family member, cDNA and protein columns) from the paper Markdown; every row was checked against the table by eye and all spans are copied from the table lines. Family-member relations ('Daughter', 'Father', 'Paternal Grandmother' etc.) are read as relations to the index case of the same family; sex was taken from these relation words, and from 'her' (HA20-1) and 'his' (HA20-14) in the text. Inheritance: children of an index case get 'inherited unspecified parent' because Table S1 lists the index case (sex not stated) with the same variant; HA20-23 (Family-3 index) gets 'inherited paternal' because the Father (HA20-25) carries the same variant; HA20-25 gets 'inherited maternal' because the Paternal Grandmother (his mother, HA20-24) carries it. The Family-2 granddaughter (HA20-22), the Family-4 brother (HA20-27), the paternal grandmother and all other index cases are 'not reported'. Zygosity is 'not reported' for everyone: the paper's 'heterozygous TNFAIP3 loss' wording is a general statement about the cohort, not per person (D-29). HA20-13 (c.(?_-1)_(*1_?)del) is not typed because no class is stated in words; HA20-15 is typed 'large deletion/CNV' from 'chromosomal deletion in 6q23.3, which encompasses TNFAIP3'. HA20-2 and HA20-23 to HA20-25 have 'intron 2'/'intron 5' in the protein column, so protein_hgvs is null. The transcript NM_006290.4 printed in the text belongs to a somatic MF/SS lymphoma variant and was not used. Left out: the somatic second hits in HA20-14's lymphoma tissue (TNFAIP3 c.1880_1881delGT, MYD88 c.617C > G; recorded only as feature detail), and all ABC DLBCL and MF/SS lymphoma cases (Table S2; somatic variants, no HA20), healthy donors and mice. 'Two patients from our cohort of 34 individuals developed lymphoma' names HA20-14 and HA20-15, but lymphoma was not marked excluded for the other 32 because the authors state no standardized monitoring was performed. No checklist item is addressed for any individual, so all checklist rows are 'not reported'; lymphoma was not counted as 'lymphoproliferation or lymphadenopathy'. cites_prior_report_of_same_patients is null: the paper says only that functional information of 'already published TNFAIP3 mutations from HA20 families' is in Infevers and that HA20-14's germline variant was 'previously identified', without naming an earlier report of these patients. Contradictions: the single-cell PBMC patients are 'HA20-1 and HA20-21' in the Results and Methods but 'HA20-1: 1454 cells; HA20-34: 6237 cells' in the Fig. 6C legend; the ABC DLBCL cohort is given as 51, 66 and 68 patients in different places (out of scope).
